method: Independent read-only comparison of sanitized run, private result/log hashes and allowlisted guard metadata, EXT-F-1005-T16/T18 inventory criteria, and native runner/harness source. No browser, build, or tests were run; no raw log, DOM, clipboard, auth, or event text was emitted.

allowlisted_records: RESOURCE_ADMITTED in run mode with no admission reasons
private_guard_log.wrapper_exit: wrapperExitCode=0 is recorded by the sanitized run; the private log has no independent wrapper-exit field.

evidence.artifact: Independently recomputed current 0.2.89 unpacked tree hash matches the named local-development receipt; the native runner also verifies the tree before and after its owned-profile run.

case_verdicts.supported_observation: Natural rows produced a proper filtered subset (64 natural rows, 11 filtered); chronological ordering was checked, and the downloaded .log exactly matched the rendered filtered-row oracle (802 bytes).
case_verdicts.gap: Clipboard read was unavailable. Runner source skips the Copy all action when the initial clipboard snapshot cannot be read; exact clipboard contents and Copied feedback therefore were not observed. Inventory acceptance requires both clipboard/download correctness and copy feedback.

case_verdicts.supported_observation: Real admin session; the storage-backed verbosity value changed through the UI, survived a real panel-document reload, and the currently visible paused feed sequence remained unchanged. Original verbosity was restored.
case_verdicts.gap: The run does not establish behavior under the inventory's service-error dimension or prove future/new event rows across levels remain visible after the toggle. Console mirroring itself is not an explicit expected clause in the current inventory row; its absence alone is not an inventory failure.

allowed_inventory_observations.record_as: bounded supporting evidence only; leave overall case unverified
allowed_inventory_observations.observation: For a real natural-event filtered subset, Download .log exactly matched the independently reconstructed rendered-row oracle in chronological order. Copy all exactness and feedback remain unobserved because clipboard read was unavailable and Copy was not dispatched.

allowed_inventory_observations.record_as: partial warm/reload evidence only; do not mark the case full pass
allowed_inventory_observations.observation: Admin verbosity UI/storage agreed, changed, persisted after actual panel reload, and the existing paused feed sequence was unchanged. Service-error behavior and future event-level feed retention remain unverified. Console-mirroring is not required by the current inventory expected text.

open_questions: T16 still needs an environment that can observe clipboard contents and copy feedback for full acceptance.
T18 still needs the missing service-error evidence and a forcing observation for feed retention as events arrive after verbosity changes.
